items.reason: Aphra's text is "Discard 3 cards from your deck. You may return an Underworld card discarded this way to your hand." Nothing plays or puts a unit into play, so it feeds nothing for Ritual Dragon; agrees with haiku.

Raze to Ruin says "Each player discards all but 3 cards from their hand"; it does not reward a bigger hand, and extra cards from "On Attack: Draw a card." are simply discarded. Overrides haiku: no hand-size payoff.
"You may ready a resource" adds no resource, so it never helps "If you control 6 or more resources"; agrees with haiku.
"You may give a Weakness token to a unit. If it's a <uq> unit, exhaust it." can exhaust a friendly unique unit, giving Palpatine's "exhausted friendly unit" a target; agrees with haiku.
Battle Fury discards "a card from your hand"; Sebulba's Podracer needs "a card from your deck". Agrees with haiku.

A's text plays "a card named It's Worse" only if the opponent answers "It could be worse", and nothing inline says that card is a unit costing 4+ for Grogu's "play a <uq> unit that costs 4 or more". Agrees with haiku.

Pong Krell "may defeat a unit with less remaining HP than this unit's power", which can be an enemy unit, and that defeat can fire Dengar's "When a unit with the highest cost among enemy units is defeated" if it is the costliest. Agrees with haiku.
Elia Kane's resource swap hits the enemy's resources: "its controller puts the top card of their deck into play as a resource". It gives the player no extra resource; agrees with haiku.
Ima-Gun Di has "When Defeated:" and Thrawn "When you use a 'When Defeated' ability: ... use that ability again". Agrees with haiku.

"Play up to 3 non-Vehicle units that each cost 2 or less from your discard pile for free" are plays, triggering Insurgent Camp's "When you play a unit with 3 or less power" for cheap units. Agrees with haiku.
"Each other friendly unit gains Hidden" makes targets for "up to 3 friendly units with Hidden". Agrees with haiku.

Thrawn's deploy side reads "On Attack: If you control more units than the defending player, you may defeat a non-leader unit they control", which triggers HK-47's "When an enemy unit is defeated". Agrees with haiku.
"Exhaust a unit" can hit an enemy ground unit, giving Assassin Probe's "each exhausted enemy ground unit" a target. Agrees with haiku.
The Tree Remembers says "An enemy unit ... defeat it"; Tantive IV needs "a friendly unit was defeated this phase". Agrees with haiku.
"give a Weakness token to a unit" can target an enemy, enabling Nuvo Vindi's "enemy unit with a Weakness token on it is defeated". Agrees with haiku.
Trap Field says "You may defeat this upgrade", not a unit, so Bothan-5's "another friendly non-Vehicle unit is defeated" never fires; agrees with haiku.
Wingman Victor Two has Piloting ("play this as an upgrade on a friendly Vehicle without a Pilot") and Red Leader is a Vehicle with "When a Pilot upgrade attaches to this unit". Agrees with haiku.
Jod Na Nawood has a "When Played:" ability and Aethersprite says "you may use that ability again". Agrees with haiku.

Sabine: "the next unit you play this phase gains Shielded for this phase"; The Armorer gives a Shield token "to each friendly unit with Shielded". Works if the Armorer is played after that unit; agrees with haiku.
"You may defeat this unit" is a friendly defeat that triggers "When a friendly unit is defeated: Heal 1 damage". Agrees with haiku.
"Other friendly units gain Hidden" gives targets for "friendly units with Hidden". Agrees with haiku.
Rex gives "this unit and an enemy unit Sentinel for this phase"; Refugee shields "a unit with Sentinel". Agrees with haiku.
Boba Fett's "exhaust this leader" exhausts the undeployed leader card, which is not a unit, and his deploy side has no exhaust; Palpatine needs an "exhausted friendly unit". Overrides haiku.
Sabe's "exhaust this leader" exhausts the undeployed leader, not a unit; her deploy side (Raid 1) has no exhaust, so Warrior of Clan Kryze's "another exhausted unit" is not met. Overrides haiku.
"Exhaust a unit" can hit an enemy, switching on "While an enemy unit is exhausted, this unit gains Raid 2". Agrees with haiku.
